name: Energy and critical infrastructure
description: Energy systems, utilities, strategic facilities and critical-infrastructure OSINT investigations.

entity_types.label: Energy company
entity_types.description: A specifically named company primarily involved in energy production, processing, transmission, distribution or supply.

entity_types.label: Utility operator
entity_types.description: A specifically named organization operating electricity, gas, water or district-heating utility services.

entity_types.label: Grid operator
entity_types.description: A specifically named electricity transmission or distribution system operator.

entity_types.label: Pipeline operator
entity_types.description: A specifically named organization responsible for operating an oil, gas or product pipeline.

entity_types.label: Water utility
entity_types.description: A specifically named organization responsible for water supply, treatment or wastewater services.

entity_types.label: Telecommunications operator
entity_types.description: A specifically named organization operating strategically significant telecommunications infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Infrastructure authority
entity_types.description: A specifically named public authority responsible for regulating, supervising or protecting critical infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Power plant
entity_types.description: A specifically named facility that generates electrical power.

entity_types.label: Nuclear power plant
entity_types.description: A specifically named nuclear facility used to generate electrical power.

entity_types.label: Nuclear facility
entity_types.description: A specifically named nuclear research, enrichment, fuel-processing, storage or waste-management facility.
exclude_when: Use ECI_NUCLEAR_POWER_PLANT when the named facility is specifically an electricity-generating nuclear plant.

entity_types.label: Hydroelectric plant
entity_types.description: A specifically named hydroelectric generation facility.

entity_types.label: Solar power plant
entity_types.description: A specifically named utility-scale solar generation facility.

entity_types.label: Wind farm
entity_types.description: A specifically named onshore or offshore wind-generation facility.

entity_types.label: Refinery
entity_types.description: A specifically named petroleum or hydrocarbon refining facility.

entity_types.label: Petrochemical plant
entity_types.description: A specifically named petrochemical processing or production facility.

entity_types.label: LNG terminal
entity_types.description: A specifically named liquefied-natural-gas liquefaction, import, export or regasification terminal.

entity_types.label: Oil terminal
entity_types.description: A specifically named crude-oil or petroleum-product storage, loading or transfer terminal.

entity_types.label: Fuel depot
entity_types.description: A specifically named strategic fuel-storage or distribution facility.

entity_types.label: Gas storage facility
entity_types.description: A specifically named underground or above-ground natural-gas storage facility.

entity_types.label: Electrical substation
entity_types.description: A specifically named electrical transmission or distribution substation.

entity_types.label: Infrastructure control center
entity_types.description: A specifically named control, dispatch or operations center responsible for managing critical infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Water treatment plant
entity_types.description: A specifically named drinking-water treatment facility.

entity_types.label: Wastewater treatment plant
entity_types.description: A specifically named sewage or wastewater treatment facility.

entity_types.label: Desalination plant
entity_types.description: A specifically named facility that produces fresh water through desalination.

entity_types.label: Dam
entity_types.description: A specifically named dam or water-retention structure.

entity_types.label: Reservoir
entity_types.description: A specifically named artificial reservoir associated with water or energy infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Data center
entity_types.description: A specifically named data-processing or hosting facility described as strategically or operationally significant.

entity_types.label: Cable landing station
entity_types.description: A specifically named facility where one or more submarine telecommunications cables connect to terrestrial networks.

entity_types.label: Satellite ground station
entity_types.description: A specifically named terrestrial facility used to communicate with or control satellites.

entity_types.label: Energy pipeline
entity_types.description: A specifically named oil, gas, hydrogen or petroleum-product pipeline system.

entity_types.label: Power grid
entity_types.description: A specifically named national, regional or interconnected electricity grid.

entity_types.label: Transmission line
entity_types.description: A specifically named high-voltage electricity transmission line or corridor.

entity_types.label: Electric interconnector
entity_types.description: A specifically named cross-border or interregional electricity interconnection.

entity_types.label: Submarine power cable
entity_types.description: A specifically named undersea cable used for electrical power transmission.

entity_types.label: Submarine telecommunications cable
entity_types.description: A specifically named undersea fiber-optic telecommunications cable.

entity_types.label: Water supply network
entity_types.description: A specifically named aqueduct, water-transfer system or strategic water-distribution network.

entity_types.label: District heating network
entity_types.description: A specifically named district-heating or centralized thermal-energy network.

entity_types.label: Strategic transport corridor
entity_types.description: A specifically named transport corridor explicitly described as critical to energy or infrastructure operations.

entity_types.label: Energy field
entity_types.description: A specifically named oil, natural-gas or geothermal extraction field.

entity_types.label: Offshore energy zone
entity_types.description: A specifically named offshore geographic area associated with energy extraction or generation.

entity_types.label: Energy program
entity_types.description: A specifically named national, international or corporate energy-development program.

entity_types.label: Nuclear program
entity_types.description: A specifically named civilian or dual-use nuclear-development program.

entity_types.label: Infrastructure protection program
entity_types.description: A specifically named program for protecting or increasing the resilience of critical infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Infrastructure project
entity_types.description: A specifically named project for constructing, expanding or modernizing major energy or critical infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Infrastructure incident
entity_types.description: A specifically named or conventionally identified incident affecting critical infrastructure.
exclude_when: Do not annotate routine unnamed outages, failures or maintenance events.

entity_types.label: Blackout
entity_types.description: A specifically named or conventionally identified large-scale electrical blackout.

entity_types.label: Infrastructure attack
entity_types.description: A specifically named attack or sabotage event targeting energy or critical infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Nuclear accident
entity_types.description: A specifically named nuclear or radiological accident.

entity_types.label: Energy crisis
entity_types.description: A specifically named or conventionally identified energy-supply crisis.

entity_types.label: Infrastructure emergency operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named emergency, restoration or containment operation involving critical infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Infrastructure recovery operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named operation to restore damaged or disrupted critical infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Energy agreement
entity_types.description: A specifically named interstate, public-private or commercial agreement concerning energy supply, transit or infrastructure.

entity_types.label: Energy supply contract
entity_types.description: A specifically named or identified contract for the supply of electricity, gas, oil, fuel or another energy commodity.

entity_types.label: Pipeline agreement
entity_types.description: A specifically named construction, transit, access or operating agreement concerning a pipeline.

entity_types.label: Energy market
entity_types.description: A specifically named organized electricity, gas or energy-trading market.
